system.description: The instant you enter torpor, your spirit automatically projects astrally as per Psychic Projection while your body rests. You cannot awaken your body at will beyond the normal rules for waking from torpor. If your silver cord is severed in astral combat, you become lost in the spirit realms, lose this power and half your permanent Willpower Traits (round up), and must spend a year and a night in an unwakeable torpor while your soul slowly returns, after which both the power and the lost Willpower must be bought back with experience.
